notes.title: Updated Simplified Chinese & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We just wanted to jump on here and let you know that you have been heard – there were issues with the Simplified Chinese localisation that needed fixing.

Thank you for flagging these errors and leaving feedback. We’ve since had the Simplified Chinese proof read, and it should now read smoothly and make more sense! 

[b]The updated translations are part of the latest patch, and come alongside bug fixes and fixed Air Dash mechanic. [/b]

We want everyone to be able to enjoy Gestalt: Steam & Cinder, and we hope this improved translation allows you to experience our game as it should be played. 

Any issues please do let us know. Thanks again for your support and apologies for the issues with the original localisation. 

Metamorphosis Games

notes.title: Community Update: Pre-launch FAQ
notes.notes:
It’s almost time to join Aletheia on uncovering the long-buried secrets at the heart of Canaan… Gestalt: Steam & Cinder is releasing July 16th! 

In advance of launch day, we wanted to cover a few of your questions we’ve seen popping up. 

[h3][b]What will be the price of Gestalt: Steam & Cinder?[/b][/h3] 
For launch week, we’ll have a 10% discount. Normally, the price will be £15.99/$19.99. 

[h3][b]What’s the expected length of the game?[/b] [/h3]
10 – 12 hours if you’re looking to complete everything! 

[h3][b]How many Steam achievements are there?[/b] [/h3]
36 in total. 

[h3][b]Will Gestalt be Steam Deck Compatible?[/b] [/h3]
Yes!  

[h3][b]Which languages will the game be playable in?[/b] [/h3]
Gestalt: Steam & Cinder will be localized in the following languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese. 

We’re always open to hearing where there’s additional interest in localization and considering it with the team, but we can’t promise any additional languages at the moment. 

[b]If there’s anything else you’d like to find out, please let us know in the comments! [/b]

A huge thanks to everyone who has supported us over the years. We’re thrilled to be launching our game in less than two weeks, and can’t wait for you to finally forge Aletheia’s path through the rusting streets, lairs, and ruins of the Steam City. 

This world of ancient enmities, electrifying combat, and steam-shrouded lore awaits! 

--Metamorphosis Games

notes.title: Community Update: Release date change
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, 

Firstly, [b]thank you so much[/b] for your ongoing support, especially those of you who have been here over the years. We really appreciate you bearing with us while we work on our game. 

That being said, we have an update about our release date. We're so close to the launch of Gestalt: Steam & Cinder, but we’re going to have to ask for a little more time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36874404/61b18c20a37bd064b9031e7758080c307a0eeb2f.png[/img]

This has been a difficult decision to make, but what we thought would be our last round of testing has raised some unforeseen issues which we need a few extra weeks to iron out before launch. As a result, we’re moving the release date back to [b]16th July[/b] to deliver the very best version of the game that we can. 

Apologies that this isn't the news you would have wanted to hear, and we know this will be frustrating to some of you, but we want everyone to experience the game in the best possible way. We are so thankful for your continued patience - [b]we're almost there![/b]

If you have any questions do let us know, but please rest assured we are working really hard to get Gestalt: Steam & Cinder into your hands. 

Thanks again and talk soon, 

Metamorphosis Games

notes.title: Gorgeous new steampunk action RPG finally sets Steam release date
notes.notes:
In the run-up to Hollow Knight Silksong and following some fantastic recent 2D action platformer games including the likes of Prince of Persia The Lost Crown, Blasphemous 2, and Ultros, new Steam RPG Gestalt: Steam and Cinder is one that's very much caught my eye. First debuted almost three years ago, the gorgeous new pixel art adventure is finally almost here, and you can even try it out now with a free demo.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Steam Demo v0.14.11 | Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A patch for the Gestalt: Steam and Cinder Demo has been released and includes the following changes:

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Auto Saves now takes priority over the primary save file selection if there's an auto-save available and it's newer than the last Tether Save. (Instead of being an option on the left of the file selection.) This allows players to resume progress from the most recent room if quitting to the main menu or crashing. (Some rooms such as cutscene-specific rooms don't auto-save on purpose.)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed a performance issue with the Renard and Cassandra cutscene.
[*]Fixed camera room trigger size not triggering camera room change in the vent that accesses Fenton's hidden room.
[*]Fixed energy gain graffiti tutorial's art to accurately show bullet slot filled
[*]Fixed interaction prompts on Tesla switches in rooms 1,2 and 3 not properly appearing based on the current state of the tesla switch.
[*]Fixed the layering order for map markers placed by the player.
[*]Fixed a soft-locking bug that locked Aletheia into a crouching state. This occurred when you tried to heavy-attack while crouching without having the charge blade upgrade unlocked.
[*]Fixed a typo in the Ground slam ability's description text.
[*]Fixed a typo for the word "Jotun", in Simon's dialogue after falling from the boiler room.
[*]Fixed a typo in Charge Spin's ability description text.
[*]Fixed a typo of the word "whelp" in Bram's vent conversation.
[/list]

[h2]Balances Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Increased Back Step Blade ability damage multiplier to 275% up from 225%.
[*]Increased enemy damage for the Mini M.E.S.S's shock area of effect attack to 15 up from 10.
[*]Increased enemy damage for Clockwork Mini Enforcer to 15 up from 10.
[*]Increased enemy projectile damage from Clockwork Shocker to 10 up from 5.
[*]Increased enemy projectile damage from Mini M.E.S.S to 10 up from 5.
[/list]

A big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who provide feedback and reported issues for the Demo!

[b]REMINDER![/b] You can report any issues or feedback after this patch [url=https://metamorphosisgames.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]here[/url]. Please include as much detail as you can about the issue to help us better resolve the issues you are having.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

We're so happy you seem to be enjoying the demo. We've implemented a few things to make sure that everyone gets the most out of the demo. 

Change log:
- Reload the gun on keyboard with 'O'.
- Additional tutorial text added (don't forget to roll through enemies!).
- Additional poultices added to Tartarus.
- Enemies slightly rebalanced.
- Poultices now respawn for maximum farming ahead of the boss!

We hope this makes the demo that little bit smoother. If you see any quirks in the demo or want to keep a closer eye on development as we head to release, you can join our Discord (https://discord.gg/ADAuC9)! 

Thank you so much for playing. We cannot wait to show you the rest of Canaan later this year!

-- Metamorphosis Games
